question.text: An appeal against an order of SEBI can be filed before the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) within what time period from receipt of a copy of the order?

answer.text: 30 days from receipt of a copy of the order
45 days from receipt of a copy of the order
60 days from receipt of a copy of the order
90 days from receipt of a copy of the order

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that an appeal to SAT against an order of SEBI / the adjudicating officer / IRDAI / PFRDA can be filed within 45 days from the date on which a copy of the order is received by the aggrieved person. The Trap: The trigger is receipt of a copy of the order, not the date of the order itself. Anchoring the 45-day clock to the order date can shorten the available time and is not what the workbook says. Note: 60 days applies at the next level (appeal from SAT to the Supreme Court) — do not mix the 45-day SAT timeline with the 60-day Supreme Court timeline.
